page.notes: The column is the only visible text; its main text is cut off, so the side is inferred from the position of the column. Printed long s is given as plain s (for example "Gomes" for the form that looks like "Gomef"). The column is one continuous run of lines, so it is set as one note; it may hold several separate notes, which cannot be told apart in this part. The first line of the page is the end of a sentence from the previous page.
